response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(oe.fillcount) AS group_avg FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND oe.expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.orderflow) subquery

assumptions.assumption: Timestamp comparison uses lexicographic text order, not parsed datetime semantics, per the request's explicit instruction; this is valid for ISO-formatted datetime strings with both endpoints included (>= and <=).
NULL values in fillcount are ignored by AVG(), and group averages that evaluate to NULL are also ignored by the outer AVG() — standard SQL behavior.
